summary.en: Odd meters, concept albums, extended instrumental sections.
summary.zh: 怪拍子、概念专集、扩展器乐段。

body.en: Prog rejects the three-minute single's commercial tempo. It pulls classical, jazz, and literary themes into rock. King Crimson and Pink Floyd model two paths: sharp structural experiment and album-length studio narrative.
body.zh: Prog 拒绝三分钟单曲的商业节奏。它把古典、爵士与文学主题拉进摇滚。King Crimson 与 Pink Floyd 代表两条路径：锋利的结构实验，与专辑尺度的录音室叙事。
